hooks.text: 同一难题允许抓钩、爆破、减速时间或挑拨敌人等多种解法，连吊灯也能改成燃烧瓶
hooks.excerpt: Creative Problem-Solving – There’s always more than one way forward! Grapple across pits, explode barriers, slow time, or even turn enemies against each other. Every object has multiple uses—grab a lantern from the ceiling and use it as a portable light source or an improvised flaming Molotov.
